status: Fixed structure accepted by user: Sure lets pick some stuff. Further card selections are proposals until agreed. Not an applied or tested deck.
archetype: Aggressive Naya creature midrange with counter amplification and Smile recovery

slot_groups.job: Miles plus pressure, disruption and counter support
Smile at Death recovery and counter-supported return payoffs

practical_turns.1_2: Establish real attackers or answer opposing development; protection is not independent development.
practical_turns.3: Deploy a meaningful three-drop or combine a two-drop with one-mana interaction.
practical_turns.4: Deploy the reserved payoff or double-spell; do not require a four-drop every game.
practical_turns.5_plus: Smile rebuilds after ordinary trades; use optional transforms and activations. No guaranteed turn-five land drop is claimed.

constraints: Four ordinary four-mana creatures and two five-mana spells are the fixed top-end cap.
Elspeth competes for recovery/top-end budget; she cannot be added as another unbudgeted five-drop.
Printed curve counts Miles's front once; six-mana back casting/transformation is a separately recorded mana sink.
Physical slots have one primary role; secondary synergy is not additional slots.
No dedicated ramp assumed. X and alternate-cost cards require explicit practical deployment accounting.
Preserve original budgets across edits; a structural reallocation requires explicit agreement.
No land identities, colored-source guarantees or per-color basic floors finalized before exact spells. Basic-replacement resilience remains mandatory in final mana validation.
Do not assume Smile will be drawn, survive, or recover exiled creatures. Singleton closers are variety, not reliably tutorable answers.
